name: NanoKVM
author: osia
description: NanoKVM-USB without the internet: one button starts the local server of the nanokvm-usb package and opens the KVM screen in its own window; closing the window stops the server.

barWidget.description: A NanoKVM button in the bar, shown while the nanokvm-usb package is installed. Click opens (or focuses) the KVM window, right-click closes it and stops the server.
